data: Reuse original adjusted closes, volumes, historical KOSPI200 membership and settlement calendar, 2008-01-02 through 2026-07-31, 407 securities. No current constituent reconstruction. Prior researchers have already inspected this history.
signal_definitions: NEAR: adjusted close / maximum adjusted CLOSE over last252 sessions including today; near>=0.90, top10/20 percent of eligible universe. BREAK: strict close above prior252-session maximum, one or more such events in last5 sessions and near>=0.98, cap top20% universe by nearness then momentum. MOM: 12-1 price momentum close[t-21]/close[t-252]-1 positive, top10/20% universe. JOINTa: a*nearness percentile+(1-a)*momentum percentile, positive momentum, top20% universe. Ranks use all same-date eligible universe. No historical all-time high claim because pre2008 history is absent.
universe: Membership at decision date, positive price and volume,253 valid trailing prices, finite lagged60-day volatility; quarantine ten sessions after abs log return>0.35 and >12 lagged daily sigma. This filter affects new purchases only; never winsorize actual account returns.
execution: Weekly new cohort every5 trading sessions. Decision at close t; adjusted fractional units at close t+1. Each new cohort nominal allocation5/H of current NAV. Hold each cohort H sessions, sell on next-close scheduled maturity; early exit only on observed membership exit. Net same-stock matured and new lots before charging costs. Block missing-price/zero-volume fills. Allocate no more than8% current NAV per stock when adding; market drift can exceed8%. Scale buys to available cash including all costs. No leverage or short. Cash return0. Settlement proceeds usable for same-market replacement trades. No quote/orderbook or exact limit-lock data.
costs: Kiwoom KRX standard online commission0.015% each side, confirmed 2020-09-16 through2020-12-31 universal reduction0.0113604%; other individual account promotions excluded. Actual settlement-date sale tax schedule incl KOSPI rural surtax:0.30% before2019-06-03,0.25% through2020,0.23%2021-22,0.20%2023,0.18%2024,0.15%2025,0.20%2026. Slippage3bp+impact2bp EACH side is a modeling assumption, not observed fee. Commission early years extrapolated from documented standard schedule where contemporaneous archive not located.
rolling_selection: Every decision day score complete realized strategy return histories through previous session. Training756 sessions followed by validation252 sessions; a candidate must have positive train and validation means. Top3 train netSharpes then choose highest validation netSharpe. Family-specific selectors HIGH EW, HIGH either weight, MOM EW, MOM either weight, JOINT either weight; include endpoints NEAR20 and MOM20 in JOINT selection so adding high signal is optional. Require challenger validationSharpe improvement>=0.15 for five consecutive decision days before changing policy. If no positive candidate five consecutive days, stop new cohorts and let existing cohorts mature. Existing holdings retain their assigned H; no forced liquidation on model changes. Recompute daily, execute new cohorts on preset5-day cadence. Window moves forward daily; once a test return has occurred it may inform later decisions but never an earlier one.
fixed_selection: Select best standalone HIGH_EW, MOM_EW and best HIGH/MOM/JOINT weighting candidates by development2009-2016 netSharpe, tieCAGR/name. Freeze before test summaries. Also show pure near/break families separately. No choosing best2022+ result as recommendation.
deployment: Operational rolling accounts run continuously from2017; evaluation2022+ includes real inherited holdings and realized transition costs, not spliced winner returns. Also compare all operational accounts starting with same cash balance at first2022 decision as separate fresh-start diagnostic.
controls: KOSPI and KOSPI200 price indices (not investable net ETFs); existing prior daily momentum and momentum+reversal backtests labeled reference, not matched-design causal controls. All new strategies use same data, execution and costs.
sensitivity: Freeze base selection schedules; replay slippage+impact13bp and25bp per side, zero-cost diagnostic, and missing-excluded-stock recovery0% instead of baseline100% last mark. Same-path sensitivity tests execution robustness, not retuned model.
inference: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap lengths20 and60,2000 draws on2022+ fixed comparison policy returns; confidence intervals of annualized mean difference and Sharpe difference. Exploratory uncertainty only, not correction for all prior research. Report all96 candidates, turnover, costs, exposure, annual returns,2026YTD separately and actual net order history.
limitations: No verified cash dividends/corporate payout events, actual raw integer shares, historical spread/impact, exact raw turnover capacity or all-time history. Adjusted-price source is reused and not independently audited against vintage exchange files. Baseline missing-excluded-stock payout last mark is only an assumption; sensitivity required. Cannot establish validity after2026-07-31 or pristine out-of-sample success. No brokerage orders submitted. Daily replay is not an installed recurring automation.
